name: songseeker
description: SongSeeker - Local Audio Edition (self-hosted QR music cards)

scripts.lint:python: python -m ruff check tools/ && echo 'Python lint passed'
scripts.format:python: python -m black tools/ && echo 'Python format done'
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:python
scripts.test:js: echo 'No JS unit tests yet (browser-focused). Running syntax check...' && node --check app.js && echo 'JS syntax OK'
scripts.test:python: python -m pytest tests/ -q --tb=line || (echo 'Tip: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt' && python -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"."); exec(open("tests/test_verify_music.py").read().split("if __name__")[0])' )
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:python && npm run test
